title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist VLSI
description:
**Job Title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist – Semiconductor / VLSI**

**Location:** Bellandur, Bengaluru  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Working Days:** Monday to Friday  
**Experience:** 5+ years in recruitment, including at least 2 years in VLSI/semiconductor hiring  
**Suggested CTC:** ₹8–12 LPA, depending on relevant experience and interview performance. This is a proposed budget for employer approval.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment for semiconductor and VLSI engineering positions. The candidate should have strong communication skills, technical sourcing expertise and a proven ability to drive hiring closures.

Candidates from across India who are willing to relocate to Bengaluru are welcome to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement gathering and sourcing to offer negotiation and onboarding.
* Recruit for VLSI roles across design verification, RTL design, physical design, analog/mixed-signal, layout, DFT and related engineering functions.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, professional networks and talent databases.
* Screen profiles for technical relevance, experience, compensation, notice period and location preferences.
* Coordinate technical interviews and maintain timely communication with candidates and hiring managers.
* Build talent pipelines for niche and recurring semiconductor requirements.
* Manage offer discussions, candidate engagement and joining follow-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and report hiring progress, challenges and closures.
* Work independently to meet agreed hiring targets and turnaround times.

**Required Skills**

* **5+ years of recruitment experience**, including **2+ years of VLSI/semiconductor recruitment**.
* Strong understanding of **semiconductor job roles and technical terminology**.
* Expertise in **technical sourcing, Boolean search, candidate screening and stakeholder management**.
* Excellent **verbal and written communication, negotiation and follow-up skills**.
* A proactive, persistent and results-oriented approach.
* Willingness to work **from the Bellandur office five days a week**.

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. An MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.

**Key Skills for Naukri**

* Significant experience as a PHP Developer or Senior Software Engineer working with PHP within enterprise environments.

* Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
* Experience investigating application, integration and performance issues.

* Experience supporting applications hosted in cloud and/or on-premise environments.

* Knowledge of secure coding practices and application security principles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently across multiple customers and projects.

* 5+ Years Experience with Laravel, Symfony or other modern PHP frameworks.

* Experience supporting public sector or regulated organisations.
* Experience with Oracle databases and PL/SQL development.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management or similar platforms.
* PHP, Oracle, cloud platform and/or ITIL certifications.

This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys combining software development with technical problem-solving while supporting a diverse portfolio of customer applications and services.

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. * Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
* Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
* Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
* Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements

### **What you'll bring**

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

* Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
* Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
* Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
* Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments
* Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on
* Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs

* Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure
* Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion
* Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support
* Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows
* Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. **The opportunity**

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, a part of Information Security which, enables over 400,000 individuals across 140+ countries to access systems and information securely. As part of the IAM organization, the IAM Vulnerability Manager within PSSI will be responsible for coordinating the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle for vulnerabilities reported against IAM services, platforms and assets.

The role partners closely with Global Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Operations, Architecture and Service Management teams to ensure vulnerabilities are reviewed, prioritized, assigned, tracked, reported and escalated through a consistent governance model.

This position will contribute towards the execution of the IAM vulnerability management strategy through intake coordination, prioritization, ownership validation, SLA oversight, reporting, dashboarding, escalation management and continual process improvement.

We offer opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career receiving support, coaching and feedback from colleagues around the world. This role will give you an opportunity to work with some of the best talent in the industry!

This role supports various functions, including vulnerability intake, triage, asset and owner mapping, remediation tracking, service reporting, Power BI dashboarding, escalation coordination and executive visibility across the IAM vulnerability portfolio.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Vulnerability Intake & Triage**

* Receive and review vulnerability lists reported towards IAM services and assets.
* Validate vulnerability scope, affected assets, asset owners, severity and required remediation timelines.
* Sort and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, risk exposure, impacted service, asset criticality and SLA requirements.
* Maintain an accurate vulnerability register covering ownership, status, due dates, remediation progress and risk indicators.
* Ensure vulnerability records are complete, current and aligned with organizational standards.

**Assignment & Governance**

* Assign vulnerabilities to the appropriate technical groups, including Secure Access, IDM, Directory Enablement and other IAM teams as applicable.
* Coordinate with service owners and technical leads to confirm remediation ownership and delivery accountability.
* Define and maintain governance routines for vulnerability review, follow-up, escalation and closure.
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions to resolve ownership gaps, prioritization conflicts and remediation blockers.
* Ensure the vulnerability management process remains effective, repeatable and fit for purpose.

**Remediation Tracking & SLA Oversight**

* Track remediation progress across assigned technical teams and monitor adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Identify overdue vulnerabilities, recurring blockers, dependency risks and remediation delays requiring escalation.
* Coordinate with technical teams to obtain remediation updates, target dates, closure evidence and exception details.
* Monitor aging vulnerabilities and ensure appropriate management attention for high-risk or overdue items.
* Support closure validation by ensuring remediation evidence and status updates are documented appropriately.

Proven Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online delivery and advanced email troubleshooting skills.

Practical experience independently completing enterprise migrations.

Strong understanding of DNS, mail flow, email authentication, Entra ID and security.

Ability to estimate work, document deliverables and communicate with customers professionally.

Hybrid and tenant-to-tenant migrations; BitTitan, Quest or equivalent migration tools.

Microsoft CSP/MSP experience and Microsoft technical certifications.

Defender, Purview, Intune, Microsoft Graph and advanced scripting.

Quality and timeliness of accepted project deliverables and milestone sign-off.

Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.

This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.

The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.

We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. **Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.  

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.  

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

**Job Title: International Admissions Counsellor**

**Department:** Admissions & Business Development  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years (Experience in overseas education counselling preferred)  
**Reporting To:** HR Manager

***About the Role***

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented, and student-focused International Admissions Counsellor who will be responsible for identifying prospective students, generating admission enquiries, counselling students and parents, and converting qualified leads into successful international university admissions.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong knowledge of overseas education opportunities, and the ability to understand students' academic aspirations and guide them towards suitable universities and programmes abroad.

The candidate will act as a key point of contact throughout the student's admission journey, ensuring a seamless experience from the initial enquiry to university application, offer acceptance, and enrolment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Student Counselling & Guidance**

* Counsel prospective students and parents regarding overseas education opportunities.
* Understand students' academic backgrounds, career aspirations, interests, and financial capabilities.
* Recommend suitable countries, universities, colleges, and courses based on individual profiles.
* Provide guidance on admission eligibility, academic requirements, and application procedures.
* Explain available programmes, tuition fees, scholarships, and career opportunities.
* Conduct one-on-one counselling sessions, telephonic consultations, and virtual meetings.
* Build trust and maintain long-term relationships with students and parents.

**2. Student Acquisition & Admission Conversion**

* Generate prospective student enquiries through telecalling, references, social media, educational events, and other channels.
* Proactively identify and engage potential students interested in studying abroad.
* Follow up with prospective students through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and meetings.
* Convert enquiries into counselling sessions and counselling sessions into confirmed applications and admissions.
* Maintain a healthy admission pipeline and consistently achieve assigned admission targets.
* Develop referral networks with existing students, parents, schools, colleges, and educational institutions.
* Participate in education fairs, university events, seminars, webinars, and admission drives.

**3. International University & Course Knowledge**

* Maintain updated knowledge of international universities and their admission requirements.
* Understand overseas education destinations such as:
* United Kingdom (UK)
* United States (USA)
* Canada
* Australia
* New Zealand
* Germany
* Ireland
* France and other European countries.
* Stay informed about university rankings, intakes, application deadlines, tuition fees, scholarships, and entry requirements.
* Research and identify suitable universities and programmes for prospective students.
* Keep track of changing admission policies and international education trends.

**4. Application & Documentation Management**

* Assist students with university shortlisting and application submissions.
* Guide students in preparing academic documents, SOPs, LORs, resumes, and other application requirements.
* Ensure applications are complete, accurate, and submitted within deadlines.
* Coordinate with university admission representatives and international institutional partners.
* Track application status and provide timely updates to students.
* Follow up on conditional and unconditional offer letters.
* Assist students with acceptance procedures and tuition deposit guidance.

**5. Visa & Pre-Departure Assistance**

* Provide preliminary guidance regarding student visa processes and documentation.
* Familiarise students with country-specific visa requirements and procedures.
* Coordinate with authorised visa consultants where required.
* Guide students regarding accommodation, travel, insurance, and pre-departure formalities.
* Conduct pre-departure orientation sessions to prepare students for their international education journey.

**6. Lead Management & CRM**

* Maintain an updated database of prospective students and admission enquiries.
* Record all interactions, follow-ups, counselling sessions, and application updates in the CRM.
* Categorise leads based on their interest, eligibility, budget, and admission readiness.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission reports.
* Monitor lead conversion ratios and identify opportunities to improve the admission funnel.
* Ensure no prospective student enquiry is left unattended.

**7. Business Development & Institutional Partnerships**

* Build relationships with schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and educational consultants.
* Identify opportunities for student acquisition and institutional collaborations.
* Support marketing initiatives, admission campaigns, webinars, and promotional activities.
* Represent the organisation professionally during education fairs and university meetings.
* Contribute innovative ideas to increase student enrolments and strengthen the organisation's international admissions network.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

The ideal candidate should possess the following qualities:

* **Excellent Communication Skills:** Fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication abilities.
* **Active Listening:** Ability to understand students' concerns, aspirations, and expectations.
* **Persuasive Skills:** Ability to influence decisions ethically and convert prospective enquiries into admissions.
* **Empathy & Patience:** Must be approachable, supportive, and patient while dealing with students and parents.
* **Sales & Conversion Mindset:** Ability to work towards targets and achieve admission conversion goals.
* **Relationship Management:** Ability to establish trust and maintain strong relationships with prospective students.
* **Problem-Solving Ability:** Ability to address student concerns and provide practical solutions.
* **Research & Analytical Skills:** Ability to compare universities, courses, eligibility criteria, and admission opportunities.
* **Time Management:** Ability to manage multiple student applications and deadlines simultaneously.
* **Negotiation Skills:** Ability to handle fee-related discussions, objections, and parent concerns professionally.
* **Attention to Detail:** Accuracy in application documentation and student records.
* **Professionalism:** Strong ownership, accountability, ethical conduct, and a student-first approach.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 1–4 years of experience in admissions counselling, overseas education, student recruitment, educational sales, or business development.
* Prior experience with international university applications and student admissions will be an advantage.
* Freshers with exceptional communication, interpersonal, and sales abilities may also be considered.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, MS Excel, Google Workspace, and digital communication tools.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified student leads generated.
* Number of counselling sessions conducted.
* Lead-to-counselling conversion ratio.
* Counselling-to-application conversion ratio.
* Application-to-offer conversion ratio.
* Offer-to-enrolment conversion ratio.
* Number of confirmed student admissions.
* Follow-up efficiency and lead response time.
* Student and parent satisfaction.
* Accuracy and timely completion of applications.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly admission targets.

**Personal Attributes We Value**

**We are looking for someone who is:**

* Highly motivated and passionate about education.
* Confident, articulate, and approachable.
* Target-driven without compromising student interests.
* Proactive and capable of working independently.
* Adaptable to changing international admission requirements.
* Comfortable interacting with students, parents, and international university representatives.
* Willing to learn, take ownership, and contribute to business growth.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in the international education sector.
* Professional growth and learning opportunities.
* Exposure to international universities and education systems.
* Performance-based incentives linked to admission conversions.
* A collaborative and growth-oriented working environment.

**Our Expectation:** We are looking for an individual who does not simply answer admission enquiries but takes ownership of the complete student journey - from the first interaction to successful international enrolment.

**Your role at Dynatrace**
--------------------------

The **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** is a trusted technical advisor and primary account contact for key Dynatrace customers, accountable for platform success, adoption, and long-term value in complex, large-scale environments. This is a senior, enterprise-focused role that combines technical depth, business understanding, and account management. The TAM owns the overall technical relationship and is the single point of accountability between the customer and Dynatrace.

The TAM is the named owner of a defined set of Success deliverables, including platform health reviews, support case management, change window coverage, version lifecycle planning, and enhancement request advocacy, scaled to the customer’s support tier. The role is not support-centric or project-limited. It requires strong technical judgment, executive presence, and ownership across long-running engagements, and it operates at the highest tier of the Dynatrace Success offering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Success Planning:** Maintain a success plan tied to customer business objectives and manage end-to-end service delivery.
* **Technical Advisory:** Act as primary technical authority on architecture, platform health reviews, and guidance through platform transitions and modernization.
* **Adoption & Optimization:** Drive adoption through enablement plans, new use cases, and best practices.
* **Consumption & Value:** Monitor usage and consumption and recommend actions that deliver measurable outcomes.
* **Executive Engagement:** Deliver QBRs and executive checkpoints that align Dynatrace capabilities to business goals.
* **Risk & Escalation:** Identify and escalate risks before they impact the customer.
* **Internal Advocacy:** Represent the customer across Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success.
* **Operational Excellence:** Run environment evaluations and new-release reviews, coordinate customer events (e.g., Dynadays, workshops), and help establish a Dynatrace center of excellence and governance model.
* **Support Case Reviews:** Review open and recent cases to spot trends, speed resolution, prevent recurrence, and act as the escalation point.
* **Enhancement Requests:** Guide customers in submitting feature requests and advocate for their prioritization with Product Management.
* **Change Window Support:** Provide coverage during planned changes, upgrades, and migrations.
* **After-Hours & Event Support:** Provide planned on-call coverage for critical moments such as major retail events and product launches, with reasonable advance notice.
* **Cadenced Meetings:** Lead recurring account and success meetings (weekly at Signature tier).

**What will help you succeed**
------------------------------

* Deep, hands‑on technical expertise with the Dynatrace platform and enterprise observability architectures.
* Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex enterprise customers.
* Proven ability to define, communicate, and manage success plans, including clear milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes aligned to customer objectives.
* Strong understanding of modern application stacks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud‑native technologies (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Proven ability to operate independently as a senior technical advisor in high‑visibility customer situations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to executive audiences.
* Strong capability to coordinate and influence cross‑functional teams (Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales) without direct authority.
* Experience proactively identifying and managing program risks, escalation paths, and recovery plans in complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to balance strategic planning and hands‑on execution in high‑ambiguity, high‑visibility customer situations.
* Skilled in executive‑level program communication, including status reporting, expectation setting, and outcome‑based progress reviews (e.g., QBRs, steering meetings).
* Track record of driving accountability across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met and outcomes are delivered as planned.
* Demonstrated experience delivering within a structured, tiered customer success or support framework, with the ability to adapt engagement depth, meeting cadence, and deliverable scope to match contracted service levels.
* Experience owning case management and escalation resolution on behalf of enterprise customers, including trend analysis, cross-team coordination, and driving cases to closure within agreed SLAs.
* Proven ability to support customers through high-stakes production changes, upgrades, and maintenance windows, including cutover planning, real-time issue response, and post-change validation.
* Hands-on experience integrating observability platforms with ITSM and CMDB tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), with a solid understanding of how enterprises change management processes operate in production environments.
* Prior experience acting as a long‑term technical owner for strategic accounts (Preferred).
* History of influencing outcomes across teams without formal authority (Preferred).
* Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving role definitions (pilot or transformation experience) (Preferred).

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**
----------------------------------------

* Dynatrace is a leader in **unified observability** and **security** .
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with **Dynatrace Intelligence** —the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

**Note to Recruiters and Agencies** : Thank you for your interest in Dynatrace. Please note that **we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes** —do not forward them via our website or directly to Dynatrace employees. Dynatrace will not pay fees for unsolicited resumes, and any resumes received this way will be considered the property of Dynatrace.

**Benefits and work-life perks**
--------------------------------

We offer best-in-class core rewards, including paid time off, financial security benefits, retirement savings plans, and health insurance. Beyond that, you’ll get other benefits and work-life perks designed to make your ride with us even more rewarding.

#### **Mental health support**

Our Employee Assistance Program, powered by Telus Health, offers support for you and your family members.

#### **Wellness Days**

Four company-designated extra paid days off for you to recharge batteries.

#### **Flexibility**

Our hybrid working model and flexible working hours offer you the flexibility you need.

#### **AI-driven workflows**

Use AI as your daily teammate to automate tasks and focus on what matters.

#### **Learn & develop**

Company-wide learning perks, designated team's learning days, and more.

#### **Volunteering day**

A day of paid volunteer time to support a community or cause you care about.

#### **Regular team events**

We host Global Culture Parties, Family & Friends at Work Day, Global Breakfasts, Green Weeks, Pride Month, and beyond!

#### **International vibe**

Most of our offices and teams are proudly multicultural. English is our shared language, but we embrace and learn from each other's cultures.

Rewards vary depending on your employment type. Some benefits and perks also differ by location — explore your city to see what’s available there.

**About Dynatrace**
-------------------

Dynatrace (NYSE: DT) is the leading AI-powered observability and security platform. We're advancing observability for today's digital businesses, helping transform modern digital ecosystems' complexity into powerful business assets.

Our AI-driven insights cut through the noise, allowing customers to focus on what truly matters by automating manual tasks and resolving issues with pinpoint accuracy. Dynatrace offers simplicity, clarity, and reliability at scale to ensure teams can make informed decisions, minimize downtime, and drive their business forward with confidence.

* Experience integrating solutions using REST APIs (authentication, error handling, JSON processing).
* Understanding of RPA or test automation tools and concepts (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, Selenium, Playwright, etc.).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a track record of turning business requirements into technical AI/automation solutions.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams (HR, Payroll, Finance, IT).

description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the design development of complex and large-scale projects from concept to execution.
* Translate client requirements into design strategies, plans, and deliverables.
* Oversee and review architectural drawings, specifications, and 3D models to ensure design integrity.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, interior, landscape, and other consultants for integrated solutions.
* Ensure code compliance (local building regulations, NBC, fire safety, sustainability standards, etc.).
* Manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables to achieve design and technical goals.
* Guide and mentor the architecture team; review work and provide constructive feedback.
* Support business development by contributing to proposals, presentations, and client pitches.
* Stay updated on emerging materials, technologies, and design trends to enhance project quality.
* Conduct periodic site reviews to ensure design intent and quality standards are maintained.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong design sensibility with proven experience on large and complex projects.
* Excellent knowledge of building codes, NBC, local regulations, and sustainable design principles.
* Proficiency in BIM and CAD platforms (Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp) and presentation tools.
* Strong project management and coordination skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients, consultants, and internal teams.
* Leadership ability to mentor junior architects and drive a collaborative design process.
* Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and technical depth.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch.).
* Master's Degree in Architecture is preferred.
* Registered Architect with relevant professional body/council registration.

  
**Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We are seeking an experienced Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) Consultant specializing in SAP Enable Now and WalkMe. In this role, you will lead the strategic assessment, content redesign, and technical execution of migrating digital adoption assets from SAP Enable Now to WalkMe across enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Salesforce).

  

The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise in authoring and administering both platforms, understands migration patterns (content mapping, variable replacement, automated guidance), and has proven experience orchestrating end-to-end platform cutovers.

description:
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

* Provide advanced technical support for Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP), including sensitivity labels, label policies, auto-labeling, encryption, and complex issue escalation.
* Monitor and improve the health, scalability, and security of Purview DLP and MPIP configurations, clients, and connected agents; maintain secure versions and mitigate identified risks.
* Troubleshoot DLP policy and sensitivity-label deployments, label-policy and auto-labeling behavior, Endpoint DLP onboarding and agent synchronization, and alert and incident triage.
* Manage the lifecycle of DLP policies and sensitivity labels, including policy tuning, simulation mode, enforcement rollout, exception handling, change control, and reviews of Activity Explorer and Content Explorer.
* Architect automated monitoring, alerting, and remediation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, Microsoft Sentinel, and Power Automate; analyze service trends to reduce recurring issues and false positives.

description:
**Job Summary**

The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing and executing the complete recruitment lifecycle, including manpower requirement coordination, candidate sourcing, resume screening, shortlisting, interview coordination, selection, offer follow-ups, joining formalities, onboarding, and employee induction.

The candidate will coordinate with various departments to understand hiring requirements, maintain a continuous pipeline of qualified candidates, and ensure that recruitment targets are achieved within defined timelines.

The role will also involve maintaining recruitment databases, tracking hiring performance, preparing recruitment MIS reports, and ensuring a smooth candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Planning & Coordination**

a. Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements and hiring priorities.

b. Collect job requirements, qualifications, experience, skills, and other role-specific expectations.

c. Prepare and maintain monthly recruitment plans based on approved vacancies.

d. Prioritize open positions and ensure timely follow-up with respective departments.

e. Maintain an updated list of open, pending, and closed positions.

**2. Candidate Sourcing & Shortlisting**

a. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, consultants, and other recruitment channels.

b. Identify and build a database of suitable candidates for current and future requirements.

c. Review resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.

d. Conduct initial telephonic screening to evaluate candidate suitability.

e. Assess candidates based on experience, technical skills, communication, salary expectations, and availability.

f. Share relevant shortlisted profiles with respective department heads.

**3. Interview Coordination & Management**

a. Schedule and coordinate interviews with candidates and respective department heads.

b. Conduct initial HR screening and interviews wherever required.

c. Ensure candidates are properly informed about interview schedules and requirements.

d. Coordinate with interview panels and collect interview feedback.

e. Maintain interview records and update candidate selection status.

f. Follow up with candidates and hiring managers to ensure timely interview completion.

**4. Selection & Offer Management**

a. Coordinate with department heads regarding candidate selection and final feedback.

b. Discuss salary expectations, availability, and joining timelines with selected candidates.

c. Coordinate internal approvals for salary and offer release.

d. Prepare and coordinate offer letters with the authorized team.

e. Follow up with selected candidates for offer acceptance and joining confirmation.

f. Maintain regular communication with candidates until their date of joining.

**5. Employee Background Verification**

a. Initiate and coordinate background verification for selected candidates as per company policy.

b. Verify relevant details such as previous employment, educational qualifications, identity, address, and other required information.

c. Collect necessary documents and candidate consent for the verification process.

d. Coordinate with background verification agencies or relevant internal teams to track verification progress.

e. Follow up on discrepancies or adverse findings and escalate them to the HR Head/Management for review.

f. Maintain confidential records of background verification reports and ensure proper documentation.

g. Track completion of the required verification process and coordinate any pending actions before or after joining, as applicable under company policy.

**6. Joining, Onboarding & Employee Induction**

a. Coordinate joining formalities and collection of required employee documents.

b. Confirm joining dates and communicate joining details to candidates and concerned departments.

c. Coordinate with Admin and respective departments to ensure new employee joining readiness.

d. Conduct and coordinate employee induction and orientation.

e. Introduce new employees to company policies, departments, reporting structures, and workplace practices.

f. Ensure completion of joining documentation and onboarding records.

g. Maintain proper employee joining and induction records.

**7. Recruitment Targets & Performance Tracking**

a. Work towards achieving assigned monthly hiring targets.

b. Maintain a continuous pipeline of candidates to meet current manpower requirements.

c. Track sourcing, screening, shortlisting, interviews, selections, offers, and actual joinings.

d. Monitor candidate conversion from interview to selection and selection to joining.

e. Take proactive action to minimize candidate dropouts and recruitment delays.

f. Ensure vacancies are closed within agreed recruitment timelines.

**8. Recruitment MIS & Documentation**

a. Maintain daily recruitment trackers and candidate databases.

b. Prepare weekly and monthly recruitment performance reports.

c. Track department-wise hiring requirements and recruitment status.

d. Maintain records of shortlisted, interviewed, selected, rejected, and joined candidates.

e. Report hiring progress, challenges, and pending requirements to management.

f. Ensure recruitment documentation is accurate and properly maintained.

**9. Cross-Functional Coordination**

a. Work closely with HR, Admin, Department Heads, and Management.

b. Coordinate with different teams to understand their manpower requirements.

c. Follow up on pending interview feedback, approvals, and joining formalities.

d. Ensure smooth communication between candidates and internal teams.

description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Industry Health Care

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The company**

TRS / dAIgnostiX provides teleradiology and diagnostic reporting to hospitals and imaging centres in the US and international markets. The company is well funded and aiming for high growth at >25% CAGR. It is investing in the leadership team that will get it there.

**The opportunity**

TRS is set for rapid growth, at a CAGR above 25%. That growth depends on American Board Radiologists (ABRs): the size, deployment and satisfaction (NPS) of the ABR panel is the binding constraint. The panel has about 100 ABRs today, with a substantial increase planned in the coming months.

The ABR journey is split across several teams, including Onboarding, Scheduling and Assigning, and no one owns the ABR's experience end to end. The result is a paradox: the company reports a capacity shortage, while ABRs say they are underused. Part of the capacity gap is really a deployment gap, and closing it is faster than recruiting alone.

This role is the single owner of that journey. You will lead everything that decides whether an ABR is credentialed, scheduled, supported and productive. You will own ABR capacity and productivity, and ABR satisfaction.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Own Radiologist (ABR) capacity and productivity . Be the named owner of ABR utilisation (actual vs. contracted hours), productivity, and the capacity gap against planned revenue. Make these live, per-ABR numbers, not a one-off analysis. Calculate the capacity gap net of utilisation recovery, so recruiting decisions rest on real utilisation rather than an inflated shortage.
* Deploy before you recruit. Run an ABR-by-ABR diagnostic across the full roster, starting with the highest-hours group. Tag a root cause and a named owner for each, and work through the fixes with Operations Delivery, who own case assignment.
* Own the pipeline from offer to first live shift. Recruitment and HR source candidates; you own everything after: offer, licensing and credentialing, orientation and the first live shift. Set a time-to-first-read target and keep bringing it down.
* Credential to match demand. Credential against forecast demand, not whoever is next in the queue. Introduce a rule that each ABR agrees their hospital list before applications start. Set up a live credentialing feed into Scheduling, so a hospital approved on Monday can be scheduled on Tuesday.
* Run ABR experience and engagement. Give every ABR one point of contact and a set rhythm: a weekly pulse, a monthly review and a quarterly plan. Track every concern from intake to closure: acknowledge within 24 hours, and resolve operational and IT issues within 48–72 hours. Set up a real ABR satisfaction measure (an open item in the KPI framework today). Manage no-show rate and annualized attrition as leading indicators, not just reported numbers.
* Shape the ABR proposition: technology, terms and training. Be the ABR's voice wherever their working day is shaped.
* Technology first. Image load, dictation workflow, RADSpa friction and pre-read or AI support are the most common complaints. Sponsor a ranked fix list with the technology team, and a pre-read pilot with volunteer ABRs, measured in RVUs per hour.
* Training. Shape training and onboarding of new and existing ABRs
* Chair the shared ABR-capacity forum. Run forum that brings together scheduling decisions, credentialing status, assignment practice and utilisation data. Keep one shared tracker so every team sees gaps at the same time, and agree a clear escalation path.
* Build the leadership bench. Build a real management layer with succession depth as the roster and volume triple, and give new leaders the structure, tools and coaching to grow.

### **Requirements**

**Candidate profile**

  

* 7–8 years of experience in hospital operations, healthcare administration or clinical operations.
* Strong understanding of hospital operations, healthcare workflows and administrative processes.
* Experience coordinating with doctors, consultants, radiologists or other medical professionals.
* Exposure to workforce planning, scheduling, resource utilisation and operational management.
* Should have experience managing multi-functional hospital operations teams, overseeing day-to-day healthcare operations, coordinating with doctors and medical professionals, and driving operational efficiency.

**Educational Qualification**

  

* Master's degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) or MBA in Hospital Management.
* Candidates with relevant postgraduate qualifications in Healthcare Management may also be considered.
